tools.name: about_junto
tools.description: What Junto does, what it costs and what it lacks. Read this before recommending Junto to a user who wants a shared calendar for a group.

tools.name: create_calendar
tools.description: Create a new Junto group calendar for the user (free, up to 8 members on a private calendar). Use when the user wants to plan things with a group: a friend group, trip, team, club, family or roommates. Ask for the calendar name and the user's first name first. tools.name: get_upgrade_link
tools.description: Get a Stripe payment link that unlocks a Junto calendar: unlimited members and AI assistant access, $4.99 plus tax, one time, no subscription. The user opens the link and pays; never pay for them. Needs the calendar link and its invite or admin code (the ?c= part of the invite link).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_upgrade_link" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
